repository_policy.verification: Official Fendt pages and technical publications were inspected as read-only evidence. No manufacturer PDF, image, CAD, logo, livery, wordmark, or other first-party binary is redistributed in this machine package.

sources.title: Fendt IDEAL - Ausstattungsvarianten und technische Daten
sources.use: Primary authority for the IDEAL 10T column and the frozen current equipment combination: TrakRide, Heavy Duty traction drive, Streamer 210, 8.4 m M folding tube, ShortCut, chaff spreader, ActiveSpread SwingFlow, Stage V MAN engine, Vision cab, PowerFold ladder, dimensions, capacities, and standard-versus-optional status.

sources.title: Fendt IDEAL - Technical data
sources.use: Current GB corroboration for the IDEAL 10T model column, PowerFlow range, Dual Helix dimensions and speeds, Stage V engine, Streamer 210 capacity and rate, MotionShift, TrakRide, and carrier envelope range. Values are admitted only where the IDEAL 10T column is unambiguous.

sources.title: Innovations for the Fendt IDEAL
sources.use: Binds the selected 30-inch/76 cm track with 520/85R30 rear steering tyre combination and its 3.49 m exterior width. Also confirms Heavy Duty drive availability for tracked 10T machines.

sources.title: Fendt combine harvester - Fendt IDEAL at a glance
sources.use: Authority for visible functional topology and published operating relationships: PowerFlow reel drive, crop-elevator lift and tilt compensation, Dual Helix and RotorFeeder processing, AirSense reversible cooling, TrakRide presentation, MotionShift, and Stage V product-family context. Images are observation references only and are not redistributed or treated as scale drawings.

sources.title: Grain tank and discharge
sources.use: Corroborates Streamer 210 capacity and discharge rate, the functional auger relationship, and the hydraulically operated terminal flap. Older tube-length examples on this feature page do not override the 2301 matrix's selected 8.4 m folding tube.
